summary: Before moving adoption, a member asks {honoree} to confirm the choices for both sides of the medal.
realLife: Donald Scarinci checked Everett Alvarez Jr.'s preferences with him at the meeting before proposing that the committee recommend his two designs.
gates: The honoree is present and has seen designs for both faces.
inGame: needs: honoree preferences for both faces.

turns.what: The honoree likes the front alone.
turns.pulledBy: The other side depicts a different recollection of the event.
turns.writesBack: The motion names only the agreed face.

turns.pulledBy: The artist has submitted two accurate versions.
turns.writesBack: Members score both on their own judgment.
